intro: Chol'aruk the Ravener is a hunt in the Barrens targeting a colossal quilboar rumored to dwell in a cavern at Thorn Hill. Believing the dire tales after past encounters with similar beasts, the orc Gur'ak tasks adventurers with braving its lair and bringing back its head.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You there, adventurer. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.
Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.
Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.
